category: Items typically peeled before use or consumption
explanation: Banana, Orange, Potato, and Onion are almost universally peeled before eating or cooking. An Apple, while it can be peeled, is very commonly consumed with its skin on.

category: Signers of the U.S. Declaration of Independence
explanation: John Adams, Benjamin Franklin, Thomas Jefferson, and John Hancock were all signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence. George Washington, while a pivotal Founding Father and Commander-in-Chief of the Continental Army, was not present at the Second Continental Congress to sign the Declaration, as he was leading the troops in New York.

Wave (a wave breaks), Dawn (day breaks), Record (break a record), and Silence (break the silence) are all concepts or phenomena that can be 'broken' in a figurative or idiomatic sense. A Plate, however, is typically 'broken' in a literal, physical sense.
